channel.title: SSbusinessAndMarket
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbusinessAndMarket, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Grok Bot is growing fast—but Elon Musk says its costs are ‘unsustainably high’ compared to revenue
item.description: SpaceX's AI bot has reached 800,000 paid weekly users, but Musk admits the cost of serving them is high relative to revenue.

item.title: China’s cheap exports are ‘a fact of life,’ Siam Cement Group’s CEO says—so Southeast Asia’s factories need to get bigger
item.description: The Thai industrial giant says regional scale, not national scale, is the only way to keep unit costs low enough to compete.

item.title: Kalshi’s midterm trading tops $1.4 billion as traders bet on a Democratic sweep of Congress
item.description: From Texas to Los Angeles, traders are placing their bets. Recent surprises suggest the odds warrant caution.

item.title: Musk says Grok Bot’s costs are ‘unsustainably high,’ while OpenAI admits Dots are ‘compute heavy.’ Is the personal AI agent push dead on arrival?
item.description: At a dinner in NYC, the head of ChatGPT lays out OpenAI's vision for agentic AI, but it faces some serious challenges.
